reviews.body:
Nice find, @pcbeingused333. `Configure` in `pkg/ai/customrest.go` really did drop `GetMaxTokens()` on the floor.

Read the full diff at `fd5ccbd` and checked the two claims against `main`: `pkg/ai/ollama.go` sends `maxtokens` as `options["num_predict"]` the same way, and `cmd/auth/add.go` defaults `--maxtokens` to 2048. Leaving the key out when the value is 0 is the right call, and both tests pin it. CI is green, so I'm approving.

I'm leaving the merge with Alex for one reason: every customrest provider created through `k8sgpt auth add` will start sending `num_predict: 2048` after this, so servers that honour it get a cap their users never set. That matches the other backends, but it changes what existing custom REST servers receive, and that's his call.
